name: nestjs-react-starter
description: Runs the AuthDock example end to end: Postgres (Docker), the NestJS API, and the React app, together.

scripts.db:migrate: cd ../../packages/auth-nestjs && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/authdock npx prisma generate && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/authdock npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.predev: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
